This list was taken partially taken from i-inteligence's OSINT Tools and Resources Handbook.
Thanks to our main contributors jivoi EK_ & spmedia
items.title: ↑ Credits

items.description: Google Dorks Tools

items.title: AtDork
items.description: Professional OSINT dorking tool featuring adaptive delay, circuit breaker, and automatic backend fallback to avoid IP bans and rate limits.

items.title: DorkCraft
items.description: Google dork generator that builds advanced search queries for OSINT and reconnaissance.

items.title: ↑ Google Dorks Tools

items.description: Search engines that can be used to check if your data's been breached

items.title: Leaker
items.description: Passive leak enumeration CLI tool that searches across 10 breach databases simultaneously.

items.title: NOX
items.description: Recursive async framework for deep breach analysis and identity pivoting.

items.title: ↑ Data Breach Search Engines
Fb-sleep-stats
items.description: Use Facebook to track your friends’ sleeping habits.

items.title: Facebook Friend List Scraper
items.description: Tool for scraping large Facebook friend lists without being rate-limited.

items.title: Osintgram
items.description: Osintgram offers an interactive shell to perform analysis on Instagram account of any users by its nickname.

items.title: Toutatis
items.description: a tool that allows you to extract information from instagrams accounts such as s, phone numbers and more

items.title: instagram_monitor
items.description: Tool for real-time tracking of Instagram users' activities and profile changes with support for email alerts, CSV logging, showing media in the terminal, anonymous story downloads and more

items.title: InstagramPrivSniffer
items.description: Views Instagram PRIVATE ACCOUNT'S media without login 😱.

items.title: Osintgraph
items.description: Tool that maps your target’s Instagram data and relationships in Neo4j for social network analysis.

items.title: insto
items.description: Interactive OSINT CLI / REPL with 35+ slash-commands: profile + media + followers + dossier + geo-fingerprint (), shared-followers intersection (), superfan ranking (), location search (), URL→metadata resolution (), posting-cadence histogram (), Maltego CSV export. Token-based (HikerAPI, no IG account needed → no ban risk) with optional logged-in backend.
*2Chat - Check if a number is on WhatsApp. *Groupio - Find and search WhatsApp groups. *Whatsapp CheckLeaked - WhatsApp Number Search & Profile Photo Checker. API Option Available.
items.title: ↑ WhatsApp
LinkedInDumper
items.description: Script to dump/scrape/extract company employees info from LinkedIn API.

items.title: the-endorser
items.description: Tool that allows you to draw out relationships between people on LinkedIn via endorsements/skills.

items.title: CCTV
items.description: Close-Circuit Telegram Vision revolutionizes location tracking with its open-source design and Telegram API integration. Offering precise tracking within 50-100 meters, users can monitor others in real-time for logistics or safety, redefining how we navigate our surroundings.

items.title: Telerecon
items.description: A reconnaissance framework for researching and investigating Telegram.

items.title: Telepahty
items.description: Telepathy is a tool that archives Telegram chats and analyzes communication patterns within the app. By providing insights into user interactions, message frequency, and content trends, Telepathy helps investigators understand the dynamics and relationships within Telegram groups and channels.

items.title: Telegram Nearby Map
items.description: Webapp based on OpenStreetMap and the official Telegram library to find the position of nearby users.

items.title: TOsint
items.description: Tosint (Telegram OSINT) is a powerful tool designed to extract valuable information from Telegram bots and channels. It serves as an essential resource for security researchers, investigators, and anyone interested in gathering insights from various Telegram entities.

items.title: Maltego Telegram
items.description: Rich Set of Entities & Transforms for OSINT on Telegram with Maltego.

items.title: TeleTracker
items.description: TeleTracker is a simple set of Python scripts designed for anyone investigating Telegram channels. It helps you send messages quickly and gather useful channel information easily.

items.title: Telegram channels scraper TeleGraphite
items.description: Telegram Scraper & JSON Exporter & telegram channels scraper.

items.title: Telegram Channel Joiner
items.description: grow your Free and Premium Telegram accounts easily with this channel joiner script.

items.title: Steam-OSINT
items.description: Open-source OSINT tool for accurate mutual friends analysis on Steam, supporting full friend lists.

items.title: OSINT-Steam
items.description: An open-source tool that returns public information, such as friends list and possible locations, from Steam profiles.

items.title: Shotstars
items.description: An advanced tool for checking GitHub repositories, with star statistics, including fake star analysis and data visualization.

items.title: github_monitor
items.description: Tool for real-time tracking of GitHub users' activities including profile and repository changes with support for email alerts, CSV logging, detection when a user blocks or unblocks you and more

items.title: Sherlock
items.description: Search for a username in multiple platforms/websites.

items.title: Maigret
items.description: Collect a dossier on a person by username.

items.title: Social Analyzer
items.description: API, CLI, and Web App for analyzing and finding a person's profile in 1000 social media \ websites

items.title: Blackbird
items.description: Search a username across over 600+ websites.

items.title: Snoop
items.description: Search for a nickname on the web (OSINT world)

items.title: user-scanner
items.description: Check a username's presence across dev/social/gaming/creator site

items.title: NexFil
items.description: checks username from almost all social network sites.

items.title: Seekr
items.description: A multi-purpose all in one toolkit for gathering and managing OSINT-Data with a neat web-interface. Can be used for note taking and username checking.

items.title: Cupidcr4wl
items.description: Username and phone number search tool that crawls adult content platforms to see if a targeted account or person is present.

items.title: Antisocial
items.description: Find forgotten accounts across 30+ platforms using three-tier verification: official APIs first, then browser automation, then HTTP content analysis. Reduces false positives to around 5%. Deep search mode adds 500+ platforms via the WhatsMyName database.

items.title: Ghunt
items.description: Investigate Google emails and documents.

items.title: Holehe
items.description: allows you to check if the mail is used on different sites like twitter, instagram and will retrieve information on sites with the forgotten password function.

items.title: Blackbird
items.description: Search for accounts associated with a given email across various platforms.

items.title: h8mail
items.description: Password Breach Hunting and Email OSINT, locally or using premium services. Supports chasing down related email.

items.title: user-scanner
items.description: Takes an email, scan on various popular sites, games and retrieve info if the email is registered there or not.

items.title: MailAccess
items.description: Free email OSINT tool, checks 800+ platforms, breach exposure via HIBP, infostealer logs via Hudson Rock, and builds a cross-platform identity graph with confidence scoring.

items.title: Gitrecon
items.description: Node.js tool to scan GitHub repositories for exposed email addresses and names.

items.title: OSINTEye
items.description: OSINT Eye: A WPF Desktop Application for GitHub Intelligence, Social Media Reconnaissance, and Subdomain Discovery

items.title: PhoneInfoga
items.description: Advanced information gathering & OSINT framework for phone numbers.

items.title: InMobPrefix
items.description: Dataset, charts, models about mobile phone numbers prefixes in India along with their respective state, operator.

items.title: openSquat
items.description: Open source tool that searches newly registered domain feeds to find typosquatting, IDN homograph, doppelganger and bitsquatting domains impersonating a given brand or keyword.

items.title: Crypto Scam & Crypto Phishing URL Threat Intel Feed
items.description: A fresh feed of crypto phishing and crypto scam websites. Automatically updated daily.

items.title: Squatm3gator
items.description: Enumerate available domains generated modifying the original domain name through different cybersquatting techniques

items.title: WebsiteTechMiner.py
items.description: automates gathering website profiling data into a CSV from the "BuiltWith" or "Wappalyzer" API for tech stack information, technographic data, website reports, website tech lookups, website architecture lookups, etc.

items.title: osint-recon
items.description: Passive OSINT reconnaissance framework in Rust: subdomains, DNS, ASN, certificate transparency history, GitHub dorking, tech fingerprinting, emails and document metadata for authorized red team engagements.

items.title: waybackpy
items.description: Python package & CLI tool that interfaces the Wayback Machine APIs.

items.title: Wayback-Archive
items.description: Download complete websites from the Wayback Machine with full asset preservation for offline viewing.

items.title: yt-dlp
items.description: Downloads videos from almost any online platform, along with information, thumbnails, subtitles, descriptions, and comments (comments only on a select few sites like Youtube and a few small sites). If a site is not supported, or a useful or crucial piece of metadata, including comments, is missing, create an issue.

items.title: Tubuep
items.description: Downloads online videos via yt-dlp, then reuploads them to the Internet Archive for preservation. Note: if you would like to archive comments too, you need to install version 0.0.33 and use the --get-comments flag, however you will still have the new yt-dlp fixes and features, but existing tubeup bugs cannot be fixed, unless you do manual work.

items.title: ↑ Video Search and Other Video Tools
Perspective
items.description: interactive data visualization and analytics component, well-suited for large, streaming and static datasets.

items.title: MetaClean
items.description: Cross-platform desktop app for removing sensitive metadata from files locally before sharing them during OSINT investigations.

items.title: Amass
items.description: The amass tool searches Internet data sources, performs brute force subdomain enumeration, searches web archives, and uses machine learning to generate additional subdomain name guesses. DNS name resolution is performed across many public servers so the authoritative server will see the traffic coming from different locations. Written in Go.

items.title: dnsx
items.description: A fast and multi-purpose DNS toolkit from ProjectDiscovery for running DNS probes, resolving records and filtering DNS responses.

items.title: Columbus Project
items.description: Columbus Project is an advanced subdomain discovery service with fast, powerful and easy to use API.

items.title: Subhunt
items.description: Multi-source subdomain enumeration tool querying crt.sh Certificate Transparency logs, HackerTarget, and RapidDNS. Features HTTP/HTTPS liveness probing with status codes, alive/dead filtering, multi-format export (TXT/JSON/CSV), and a full CLI.

items.title: SpiderFoot
items.description: SpiderFoot Github repository.

items.title: The Harvester
items.description: Gather emails, subdomains, hosts, employee names, open ports and banners from different public sources like search engines, PGP key servers and SHODAN computer database.

items.title: CrowdSec
items.description: An open source, free, and collaborative IPS/IDS software written in Go, able to analyze visitor behavior & provide an adapted response to all kinds of attacks.

items.title: Photon
items.description: Crawler designed for OSINT

items.title: ReconFTW
items.description: Automated reconnaissance framework for bug bounty and pentesting with multiple integrated tools.

items.title: Waybackurls
items.description: Fetch all URLs known by the Wayback Machine for a domain.

items.title: FOCA
items.description: Tool to find metadata and hidden information in the documents.

items.title: Datasploit
items.description: Tool to perform various OSINT techniques on usernames, emails addresses, and domains.

items.title: sn0int
items.description: Semi-automatic OSINT framework and package manager.

items.title: SpiderSuite
items.description: An advance, cross-platform, GUI web security crawler.

items.title: OsintStalker
items.description: Python script for Facebook and geolocation OSINT.

items.title: keyFinder
items.description: Chrome extension that passively discovers leaked API keys, tokens, secrets, and credentials on any web page by scanning scripts, meta tags, hidden fields, web storage, and network responses using 80+ detection patterns and Shannon entropy analysis.

items.title: Cyberbro
items.description: A self-hosted application, available as a Dockerized, for effortless searching and reputation checking of observables. Extracts IoCs from raw input and check their reputation using multiple services.

items.title: Orbit
items.description: Draws relationships between crypto wallets with recursive crawling of transaction history.

items.title: Zen
items.description: Find email addresses of Github users urls and other data effortlessly

items.title: Sub3 Suite
items.description: A research-grade suite of tools for intelligence gathering & target mapping with both active and passive(100+ modules) intelligence gathering capabilities.

items.title: LinkScope Client
items.description: LinkScope Client Github repository.

items.title: ArkhamMirror
items.description: Local-first AI document intelligence with offline RAG, contradiction detection, knowledge graphs, and vision AI table extraction.

items.title: OpenGraph Intel (OGI)
items.description: Open Source Link Analysis & OSINT Framework. AI Powered Investigation Tool

items.title: Dehashed CLI
items.description: Command-line tool for searching breach databases via DeHashed API.

items.title: PRISM
items.description: Self-hosted all-in-one OSINT platform that scans a domain, IP, email, phone, or username across 22+ modules and returns threat intel, breach data, subdomains, an OPSEC score, entity graph, GeoIP map, and HTML/PDF reports. Live demo.

items.title: pygreynoise
items.description: Greynoise Python Library

items.title: BeVigil-CLI
items.description: A unified command line interface and python library for using BeVigil OSINT API to search for assets such as subdomains, URLs, applications indexed from mobile applications.

items.title: IntelHub
items.description: Browser-based open-source OSINT extension. All analysis runs locally (no servers). Features include text profiler, metadata analyzer, site & archive analysis, reverse image search, crypto/telegram analyzers.

items.title: IntellyWeave
items.description: AI-powered OSINT platform with GLiNER entity extraction, Mapbox 3D geospatial visualization, and multi-agent archive research across 30+ international archives.

items.title: SerpScan
items.description: Powerful PHP script designed to allow you to leverage the power of dorking straight from the comfort of your command line. Analyzes data from Google, Bing, Yahoo, Yandex, and Badiu.

items.title: Glit
items.description: Retrieve all mails of users related to a git repository, a git user or a git organization.

items.title: DuckDuckGo URL scraper
items.description: A simple DuckDuckGo URL scraper.

items.title: Pyba
items.description: A browser automation framework which requires low-code to search the web and perform OSINT using DFS and BFS modes, ideal for exploratory tasks.

items.title: steam_monitor
items.description: Tool for real-time tracking of Steam players' gaming activities including detection when a user gets online/offline or plays games with support for email alerts, CSV logging, playtime stats and more

items.title: psn_monitor
items.description: Tool for real-time tracking of Sony Playstation (PSN) players gaming activities including detection when a user gets online/offline or plays games with support for email alerts, CSV logging, playtime stats and more

items.title: xbox_monitor
items.description: Tool for real-time tracking of Xbox Live players gaming activities including detection when a user gets online/offline or plays games with support for email alerts, CSV logging, playtime stats and more

items.title: lol_monitor
items.description: Tool for real-time tracking of LoL (League of Legends) players gaming activities including detection when a user starts or finishes a match with support for email alerts, CSV logging, playtime stats and more

items.title: spotify_monitor
items.description: Tool for real-time tracking of Spotify friends' listening activity including detection when user gets online & offline, played songs, its duration, skipped songs, with optional auto-play, email alerts, CSV logging, session stats and more

items.title: spotify_profile_monitor
items.description: Tool for real-time tracking of Spotify users' activities and profile changes, including playlists, with support for email alerts, CSV logging, showing media in the terminal, detection of profile picture changes and more

items.title: lastfm_monitor
items.description: Tool for real-time tracking of Last.fm users' listening activity including detection when user gets online & offline, pauses or resumes playback, all played songs, its duration, skipped songs, with optional auto-play, email alerts, CSV logging, session stats and more
